The firm also helps customers in completing their savings and investment goals in a simple, secure, and rewarding manner.

about_short_description.short_description: Cowrywise is a fintech company that simplifies access to elite financial services by making them affordable to the mass market.

product.name: Savings and Investment Platform
product.description: A digital platform that allows individuals to automate savings and invest in diverse financial assets including mutual funds and treasury bills.

product.name: Investment API
product.description: An API that integrates investment features into third-party services, providing access to diverse regulated investment products.

product.name: Cowrywise Circles
product.description: A social savings feature that enables users to save money collectively through challenges linked to sports events and group goals.

product.name: Financial Planning Tools
product.description: Online tools that help users calculate savings needs, interest returns, and plan for financial goals like education and retirement.

product.name: Cowrywise Ambassadors Program
product.description: A program that engages students nationwide to develop financial management skills and career-relevant experience through networking and internships.

product.name: Cowrywise Investment Portfolio
product.description: An equities investment product on Cowrywise that allocates client funds into Nigerian Exchange-listed stocks for higher return potential.
